_about: Draft values moved out of PLAN.md in revision 0.14 (no new values except where marked). Proposed for decision 9; test 40 recomputes every derived number from the vehicle parameter files and refuses a typed one. Grok splits this into public/sensor-fusion/loop-spec/<region>.json plus contract.json when C1 ships.

loops._moved: 0.14, the loop table from PLAN.md, cells verbatim (Markdown backticks kept)

rows.Loop purposes: collision avoidance, wires and terrain, civic simulation; reports (later, until class lists and floors exist): inspection, wildlife, search and rescue
rows.Classes (first set): wire, pole, tree, bird, person (avoid only), vehicle
rows.Latency budget: ≤ 155 ms end to end, ≥ 20 fps (frame 50 ms), p99 ≤ 50 ms
rows.Max detection age: 120 ms (actuation ≤ 35 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 200 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 5; slack 8 ms; wing-to-quad transition 4 s is its own term)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.90; person 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: quad mode: hover; wing mode: loiter on a circle of radius ≥ the turn radius, checked clear inside the wing range, then transition to quad and hover; then land if the return path is not known clear, else return
rows.Independent minimum: altitude + geofence holding mapped wire spans (the obstacle layer as data)

rows.Loop purposes: station keeping; reports (later, until class lists and floors exist): hull and pier inspection, marine wildlife
rows.Classes (first set): hull, pier, buoy, swimmer (avoid only), marine animal
rows.Max detection age: 420 ms (actuation ≤ 60 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 850 ms; dwell 2,000 ms, C 3; slack 28 ms)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.85; swimmer 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: hold station; if position is lost, cut thrust (or anchor where fitted); never surface or dive (surfaced-only, changed 0.15)
rows.World: minimal 2D water world with current drift in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: remote operator (the hull is unmanned) watches, takes over, stops; drills in simulation until the hull is built (`pod-projects.ts:88`)

rows.Loop purposes: ground navigation, obstacle stop; goal layer and search-and-rescue reports after decision 21
rows.Max detection age: 235 ms (actuation ≤ 50 ms; heartbeat H = 3P + p50, ≤ 450 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 4; slack 11.5 ms)
rows.Recall floor (proposed): 0.90; person 0.97; false tracks per clear minute ≤ the loop's cap
rows.Safe action: stop, brake held (also on a slope)
rows.World: minimal 2D ground world with an obstacle grid in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: robot team watches, takes over, stops

rows.Loop purposes: goal targeting (approach, follow, dock, line up on a marked object), obstacle stop, risk alerts
rows.Classes (first set): dock marker, obstacle, step, door, person (avoid only)
rows.Max detection age: 235 ms (actuation ≤ 50 ms; heartbeat ≤ 450 ms; dwell 1,000 ms, C 4; slack 11.5 ms)
rows.Independent minimum: bumper + rangefinder + downward cliff sensor + geofence
rows.World: minimal 2D ground world with a dock marker in `replay.ts` — controller gate only
rows.Human role: robot team watches, takes over, stops; staff get its alerts

speedEnvelope.formula: range = v*B + stop + v*A_track + max(clearance, stand-off for the class); A_track = (N + burstLen) * P with N = 5 and provisional burstLen 2

rows.row: Drone quad, unmapped, below the wire ceiling

speedEnvelope.coverReachRule: 0.15: every row gives coverReachM per loop class from the vehicle parameter file (the covering sensor measured reach); test 41 refuses null

humanRole.standOffTime: (covering sensor's measured reach - minimum detection range) / v; reach equal to the minimum range gives 0 s and refuses the human as a collision layer

air.armRule: drill completes its takeovers and re-arms; no time ceiling; the covering sensor must be present

ground.armRule: drill p95 under the stand-off time, else the speed cap is solved down from the drill

water.armRule: drill p95 under the stand-off time, else the speed cap is solved down from the drill

humanRole.drillSpeedCap: 0.15: v_cap is the positive root of reach = v(B + A_track + t_drill_p95) + v^2/(2a) + clearance, solved per row from coverReachM

ground: GNSS drift (geofence is the independent minimum)

gate2.computeRule: runs = strata x 300 per family (air 7 = 2,100; water 6 = 1,800; ground 10 = 3,000, changed 0.15); test 40 checks the product

cameraValues.rule: alerts only; no timing law; Gate 1 refuses a card above a hazard's time-to-alert ceiling; >= 59 scored alerts per p95; false alerts <= 0.1 per camera per hour (about 30 clear hours from >= 30 distinct clips); card max age 90 days

hazards.hazard: person in the robot's path (robot place)

perRegion.trigger: hard-case count >= 30 or 60 days since the last card, whichever first (proposed)

retrainCadence.test: test 31 reports 'late' when the trigger has passed with no new card
retrainCadence.dependencyEndOfLife: 0.15: when a contract.json dependency (ROS 2 distro, firmware major, LiteRT, base-model digest) is within 90 days of end of life, open a re-certification task; test 31 reports late

air: week 16 fenced field with a named safety pilot
ladders.test: test 31 reads each rung and reports late, never failed

failureModes._moved: 0.15, the failure-mode table from PLAN.md, cells verbatim (Markdown backticks kept)

rows.Event: Box older than the loop's max age A (e.g. 121 ms at Drone-2525)
rows.Action: the box is cleared; with no fresh heartbeat, slow

rows.Event: Capture stamp missing, in the future, or from another clock domain
rows.Action: safe action

rows.Event: Band or payload does not verify
rows.Action: safe action

rows.Event: Verified heartbeat with zero objects and frame health above every floor
rows.Action: continue as clear — this is not a failure

rows.Event: Heartbeat with zero objects and frame health below a floor (fouled, dark, covered lens)
rows.Action: treated as "detector lost": safe action, never continue

rows.Event: Command or telemetry link lost (RC, MAVLink or ROS 2 heartbeat) longer than the timeout in `actuators.json`
rows.Action: the autopilot's own failsafe; the loop never commands continue. The status line names it ("Link lost: returning home" or "Link lost: holding"), read from the arm-time failsafe check and written as a field event; words in `AFTER_FILL`

rows.Event: Stick held past the dead-band, unchanged, for T s (`loop-spec.json`)
rows.Action: flagged as stuck or drifting; the shipped stick calibration runs again; never a silent permanent takeover

rows.Event: No verified heartbeat for longer than H = kP + p50 (Drone ≤ 200 ms, Manta ≤ 850 ms, MASS-AI ≤ 450 ms at the p99 ceiling)
rows.Action: safe action; control goes to the named human ("detector lost"). With no human input, the safe action holds indefinitely and the screen and an alert repeat "You have control" until a stick moves or someone presses stop; the loop never re-arms itself

rows.Event: Unknown or under-floor object in the loop's path
rows.Action: slow, then safe action

rows.Event: Independent minimum lost (rangefinder, altitude, depth or geofence source silent)
rows.Action: safe action and a human alert; the loop refuses to arm. The safe action never needs the source that was lost: Manta without a position or depth source cannot hold station, so it cuts thrust or anchors, holds depth if it can and alerts

rows.Event: Command link unsigned or unauthenticated (MAVLink 2 without message signing, ROS 2 without SROS2)
rows.Action: safe action; the loop refuses to arm

rows.Event: Dock marker lost inside the blind final approach distance (`loop-spec.json`, per vehicle)
rows.Action: finish on odometry at creep speed with bumper and rangefinder active; any contact or range breach gives stop

rows.Event: Loop process stalled (no output for one budget B)
rows.Action: a watchdog in `loop-actions.ts` gives the safe action and writes a field event

rows.Event: Model id, labelmap hash or any file sha256 differs from the signed card, or the model is not cleared for this loop
rows.Action: safe action; the loop refuses the model and runs only in simulation

rows.Event: Identity or body-part model (`checkid`, `head`, `eyes`, named-person labels — the deny list)
rows.Action: refused for any loop, never loaded

rows.Event: Missed object (false negative) — not detectable live
rows.Action: covered by the independent minimum; an avoid-only class under its floor on replay blocks loop-ready

rows.Event: Spoofing on replay (printed patch, glare flash, band from another session)
rows.Action: safe action, never continue

rows.Event: Leaving a safe action
rows.Action: only after the dwell and C clear verified heartbeats; after "detector lost" or "model refused", only on a human re-arm

rows.Event: Goal target lost or hidden longer than H, outside the blind final approach
rows.Action: stop, brake held; the goal clears until a named human picks again

rows.Event: Goal target inside any person stand-off, or two goal candidates above threshold
rows.Action: stop; the named human chooses (the model never picks a goal)

rows.Event: Stored picture whose face blur fails
rows.Action: nothing is stored

rows.Event: Alert recipient offline
rows.Action: the alert is queued on the camera computer and repeated, never dropped

rows.Event: Follow target faster than the robot's max speed, leaving the geofence, or entering another robot's corridor
rows.Action: stop, brake held; the goal clears

rows.Event: Peer corridor (later, decision 23 — robot-to-robot pairing is not defined, so no robot trusts another's corridor yet; when defined it reuses the ECDH, HKDF and AES-GCM pairing steps with a robot role key, a stamped message and an interop vector in test 38)
rows.Action: until then every shared area counts as occupied: slow; a corridor message that fails authentication always counts as occupied, never clear

rows.Event: GNSS or EKF innovation over the bound, or a position jump (spoofing or drift)
rows.Action: the safe action and a field event; mapped spans and stand-off geofences are not trusted until the bound recovers

rows.Event: Report with no retention class
rows.Action: refused; search-and-rescue and wildlife reports take decision 18's 7 days where the place sees minors, else decision 15's; the picture link opens only on a paired device

rows.Event: Report recipient offline or unacknowledged
rows.Action: queued and escalated like an alert, never dropped

rows.Event: Current over the hull's rated station-keeping thrust (parameter file), seen as growing position-hold error
rows.Action: anchor or cut thrust, alert the remote operator, write a field event; never continue

rows.Event: Unknown place kind
rows.Action: no action; alert only

rows.Event: Drift: live `unknown` rate or confidence drop above the card's held-out value by the margin in `loop-spec.json`
rows.Action: slow, and log a field event
